newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Berkshire Gas cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Berkshire Gas cut to hold.

text.p: -- Edward Jones said Thursday it cut its rating for Berkshire Gas Co to hold from buy based on an expectation of flat earnings for the next several years coupled with slow customer growth in New England.

-- Additionally, the company's operating expenses are expected to rise in line with the rate of inflation for the next three years, which should nearly offset the benefits of a possible rate increase in fiscal 1999, Edward Jones said.

-- Edward Jones said the total return potential for Berkshire Gas is lower than the potential return for other growth and income stocks, although current holders are likely to receive a steady dividend stream.
-- Berkshire Gas distributes natural gas for residential, commercial and industrial use.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/16 Thursday at 16-1/16.
